description: List news articles (items). Filter by feed, folder, starred, or all; supports pagination and read/unread filtering.

batchSize.description: Max items to return (default 20, -1 for all)

id.description: Feed or folder ID when type is "feed" or "folder" (default 0)

offset.description: Return items older than this item ID (pagination)

oldestFirst.description: Return oldest items first (default newest first)

name: list_news_items
title: List News Items
